summary: E2E sweep of the Glossary Discovery + Conversion Surfaces ship. Backend: new pytest suite (13/13 pass) verifies POST /api/doogie/chat emits a `citations` SSE event BEFORE `done` with deduped, <=6 {slug,label,url} items relevant to the prompt, and that all 8 POPULAR_GLOSSARY_TERMS slugs resolve on /api/glossary/{slug} (200, real definitions, no mongo _id) plus /api/glossary list and 404 for unknown slug. Frontend: footer 'Popular Terms' column with 8 links renders on every App.js-routed page (desktop + mobile 390px) and links navigate correctly; inline dotted-underline chips render on /valuation (7), /buyer (8), /seller (6), /community/surrey (8) and /listing/30162312 primer (8) with correct /glossary/{slug} hrefs and working click-through; JSON-LD on / and /valuation contains BCFSA #167790 with zero 'PENDING'. TWO SHIP GAPS FOUND: (1) the primary Doogie surface — the sidebar 'Ask Doogie' drawer (dash-ask-input, DashboardMockup AskDoogiePanel) — ignores the new `citations` SSE event entirely, so zero chips render there; chips only appear in the App.js DoogieChat FAB panel, which is mounted only on the homepage Search panel. (2) The footer 'Popular Terms' column does NOT render on the homepage '/' (DashboardMockup layout) — the site's highest-traffic page. Also found a real overlay bug: the PIPA notice bar intercepts clicks on the cookie-consent 'Accept all' button.

ui_bugs.issue: Footer 'Popular Terms' column is absent on '/' — footer-popular-terms count = 0 on the homepage (present = 1 on /buyer /seller /valuation /community/* /glossary /listing/*). Highest-traffic page misses the internal-link surface the task was shipped for.

The bottom 'Privacy notice · BC PIPA' bar (data-testid=pipa-cookie-banner, role=dialog) overlays and intercepts pointer events on the cookie-consent card's 'Accept all' button — Playwright normal click retried for 30s and failed with 'PIPACookieBanner subtree intercepts pointer events'. Two stacked consent surfaces; user must dismiss the notice bar first. Reproducible on /glossary, /valuation, /.

doogie-fab carries a perpetual CSS animation, so it is never 'stable': scroll_into_view_if_needed / normal click time out ('element is not stable'). Had to dispatch a JS click. Non-stop motion is also an a11y (prefers-reduced-motion) concern.

Tour re-opens at 'Step 1 of 5' after the user clicks 'Skip tour' and switches dashboard panels (reproduced 3x, and also with localStorage ez_doogie_tour_seen pre-seeded via init script). It overlays the bottom-right area where the Doogie FAB lives.
JSON-LD still emits 'PENDING — insert Doug's BCFSA licence #' and 'PENDING — insert brokerage licence #' (lines 120-121). Live schema is fixed, this mockup route was missed.
Markdown tables in Doogie replies render as raw pipes in the drawer (e.g. '| Period | Coverage |').
Two <h1> elements, the first one empty (h1 count = 2, ['', 'Subject Removal']) — SEO/a11y nit on the pages the whole feature funnels traffic to.

integration_issues.flow: Doogie citation chips in the 'Ask Doogie' drawer
integration_issues.issue: DashboardMockup.jsx AskDoogiePanel SSE parser (~lines 5266-5296) only handles j.routing / j.delta / j.error — it never reads j.citations and has no chip renderer. Verified live: sent 'Explain PTT and the 2-5-10 warranty for a first-time buyer' in the drawer, full reply streamed, doogie-citations-* containers = 0 and doogie-citation-chip-* = 0, while the backend demonstrably emits citations for the same prompt. Chips DO work in the App.js DoogieChat FAB panel (2 chips: '→ PTT' /glossary/property-transfer-tax-ptt, '→ 2-5-10 Warranty' /glossary/2-5-10-home-warranty, click navigates correctly) — but that FAB is mounted only inside the homepage Search panel (DashboardMockup.jsx:2577), and App.js:10841 documents the site-wide FAB as retired. So for most users the citation-chip feature is invisible.

issues: Inline links use color:inherit (#5B6B85) identical to body text; only a subtle gold dotted underline signals a link — acceptable but low affordance, consider navy or slightly stronger underline.
Listing-detail primer sits on rgba(15,42,91,0.04) with the same muted grey text — the lightest text block on the page.
Two consent surfaces stacked simultaneously (cookie-consent card bottom-left + PIPA notice bar full-width) — visually noisy and the bar blocks the card's buttons.

action_items: Add a `citations` branch to the AskDoogiePanel SSE loop in DashboardMockup.jsx (~line 5290) and render the same chip block (data-testid=doogie-citations-{i} / doogie-citation-chip-{slug}) under each assistant message — this is the drawer users actually reach from the sidebar 'Ask Doogie'.
Render the Footer 'Popular Terms' column (or an equivalent 8-link glossary row) on the homepage '/' DashboardMockup layout.
Fix the PIPA notice bar z-index / stacking so it does not intercept clicks on the cookie-consent card's Accept all / Reject optional / Customize buttons (or show only one consent surface at a time).
Replace the two 'PENDING — insert … licence #' strings in components/HomepageLeadGenMockup.jsx (lines 120-121) with '167790'.
Stop the infinite animation on .doogie-fab (or gate it behind prefers-reduced-motion) so it is clickable/stable.
Make 'Skip tour' persist across dashboard panel switches (DoogieTour re-opens at step 1).
Nit: remove the empty first <h1> on /glossary/{slug}; render markdown tables in the Ask Doogie drawer.
critical_code_review_comments: Doogie SSE parsing is now duplicated in two places with divergent capabilities (App.js DoogieChat ~1580 handles citations; DashboardMockup AskDoogiePanel ~5266 does not). Extract one shared useDoogieStream() hook so any new SSE event type lands on every surface at once.

GlossaryProse rebuilds the candidate regex list (8 terms x aliases -> ~20 RegExp objects) on every render of every instance. Hoist the compiled candidate array to module scope — it is derived from a static config.
GlossaryProse MAX_ITER=20 silently truncates linking; fine today (8 terms) but add a comment/assert tying it to POPULAR_GLOSSARY_TERMS.length.

DashboardMockup.jsx remains >6000 lines and App.js >12600 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; the new glossary/citation code makes both harder to keep in sync (see the duplicated SSE parser above).
GlossaryPageProvider is now a no-op passthrough; either delete it and its imports or document that it is intentionally inert (CommunityPageMockupLive still wraps with it).

success_rate.frontend: ~75% (footer + inline chips + schema all pass; citation chips missing on the primary Doogie surface, footer missing on homepage, consent overlay blocks clicks)

seed_data_creation: No persistent data created. Doogie chat sessions logged under session ids prefixed TEST_ (chat_messages, 30-day TTL).
test_credentials: Admin creds available at /app/memory/test_credentials.md (doug@eztofind.ca / Doug2026Login!) — not needed for this iteration; no admin endpoints exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable knowledge: (1) /listings shows a one-time CREA consent modal — click 'I Agree — Show Me the Listings' before listing links exist; listing hrefs like /listing/30162312. (2) The homepage '/' is DashboardMockup with a left sidebar; the App.js Footer (and thus footer-popular-terms) only exists on App.js routes (/buyer,/seller,/valuation,/glossary,/community/*,/listing/*). (3) To reach the DoogieChat FAB you must be on the sidebar 'Search' panel of '/', dismiss the PIPA bar, skip the tour, then dispatch a JS click on [data-testid=doogie-fab] (normal click fails: perpetual animation), accept [data-testid=doogie-consent-accept], then use doogie-input/doogie-send. Citation chips appear within ~10s. (4) The sidebar 'Ask Doogie' drawer uses dash-ask-input / dash-ask-send and currently shows NO citation chips. (5) Backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_glossary_citations.py (all pass, ~5s).
rca_of_the_issue: Citation chips invisible for most users: the backend emits `data: {"citations":[...]}` before `done` (server.py _extract_doogie_citations, lines 1014-1054 / 1122-1126) and App.js DoogieChat (line 1580) consumes it, but DashboardMockup.jsx's AskDoogiePanel — the surface wired to the sidebar 'Ask Doogie' entry and the homepage 'Ask Doogie' CTA — has its own independent SSE reader that only branches on routing/delta/error, so the citations frame is parsed and discarded. Fix = add the citations branch + chip renderer there (or share one hook). Homepage footer gap: the Popular Terms column was added to the App.js <Footer/> only, and '/' renders DashboardMockup's own footer markup.
